one_line: For the T_65 face on b > 1, a < 1/b, 0 < j <= 1, j <= e < bj/(b-j), 0 <= c < 1/j: Phi >= 0 implies G > 0. Fully replayed EXACT, with all four positive tables (1320/6332/28758/28038) matching; the no-lift conclusion cites the negative-Phi theorem.

statements.label: Theorem 1
statements.restatement: d = 1; b > 1, 0 < a < 1/b, p > 0, q >= 0, 0 < j <= 1, j <= e < bj/(b-j), 0 <= c < 1/j. If Phi = [(p-c)j + (b-c)(p+1+a) - pa]^2 - 4ac(p-b)(p+1+a) >= 0, then G > 0. With the negative-Phi theorem and G = 0 necessity, no realizable cost of the T_65 face lies in this region.

dependencies.ref: radial necessity (paper p.27): for x = u + iv in X, C(u) = 0 and det Hess C(u) = 0
dependencies.used_for: G = 0 at every spectrally realizable point, via det H(w(g,-C/Q)) = -4 d^2 G^2/Q^2 (replayed EXACT) and C < 0 (EXACT), so Q != 0 and h = -C/Q

dependencies.ref: root_moc4_T47_negative_Phi_20261022 (no realizable point with Phi < 0, coefficients >= 0, e > 0)
